scope: Legacy Companion run() idle/speaking preparation outside browser owner thread; bounded local model/media execution ports; existing media timeline preserved.
implementation: One reusable JSON-pipe transport owns process launch, bounded request/response, owner cooperation <=100 ms, <=120 s execution timeout and process-group termination.
Model/TTS and idle/speaking media adapters have separate closed protocols and execution helpers; no Hub imports, Worker delegation or new task queues.
Idle asset/procedural rendering, lip-sync HTTP, fallback and FFmpeg run in media helper; browser/policy/lease control remains in owner thread.
Media request <=2600000 bytes, response <=10100000 bytes, PCM <=1940400 bytes, <=5 synthetic clips, <=2000000 base64 chars per clip; hash/shape checks provide technical integrity only.
SpeechAvatarPublisher accepts injected preparation port, checks segment count before publication, and anchors shared playback only after clips are prepared.
Publication terminates with meet_avatar_publication_timeout after PCM duration plus 30 s stall budget; permanent speech backpressure cannot wait forever.
